Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task or business opportunity within the TaskMaster Pro application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

title.description: The title or name of the task or business opportunity.

client.description: The client or company associated with the task.

value.description: The estimated value or potential revenue of the task.

probability.description: The probability of success for the task, expressed as a percentage.

dueDate.description: The date by which the task should be completed.

status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., backlog, prospecting, negotiation, closing, done).

priority.description: The priority level of the task (e.g., low, medium, high).

delegateTo.description: The person to whom the task is delegated.

description.description: A detailed description of the task.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile in the TaskMaster Pro application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

ownerIds.description: Array of UIDs of the team owners who invited this user. Supports belonging to multiple teams.

Prospect.title: Prospect
Prospect.description: Represents a business prospect or lead.

value.description: The estimated value of the business opportunity.

probability.description: The probability of closing the deal, as a percentage.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: Represents a chat conversation between two or more users.

memberIds.description: Array of user UIDs participating in the chat.

lastMessageTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the last message sent in the chat.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a chat.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

text.description: The text content of the message.

mediaUrl.description: URL of any media attached to the message.

timestamp.description: The time the message was sent.

readBy.description: Array of user UIDs who have read the message.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

definition.description: Stores tasks associated with a specific user. The path includes `userId` to enforce ownership, ensuring only the authenticated user can access their own tasks.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique identifier for the task.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to manage tasks and user profiles for the TaskMaster Pro application, prioritizing security, scalability, and debuggability.
